answer.reason: The verses mention Deuel only as the father of Eliasaph in lists of tribal princes and offerings, which says no more than the summary already does.
doubts: NUM 1:13 (Pagiel son of Ocran, of Asher) and NUM 2:14 (Eliasaph son of Reuel) are marked but do not name Deuel; they concern other people or a variant name.
